integration_issues.issue: When the success toast 'Mensaje fijado' is still visible over the pinned banner, clicking [data-testid='pinned-banner-unpin'] via Playwright with force=True can be intercepted by the toast overlay so the API call is not fired (banner remains and server still has pinned_message). Once the toast auto-dismisses (~4s), the ✕ works as expected. Real users unlikely to hit this because touch dispatches through the toast; but z-index of BrunoToast could sit above pinned-banner.

action_items: IMPORTANT bug fix applied by tester: chat_extras.message_reactions and chat_extras.request_transcription used `if not msg` on a projected find_one result. When the message has no `reactions`/`transcript`/`transcript_status` fields yet, Motor returns `{}` (empty dict, falsy) → the endpoints wrongly returned 404 'Mensaje no encontrado' for every fresh message. Fixed by changing to `if msg is None`. Recommend reviewing other endpoints that use projected find_one + truthiness checks to avoid the same trap (e.g. any find_one with a single boolean-or-optional projected field). This was the root cause of the failing /reactions and /transcribe calls in production too, not just tests.
Consider raising BrunoToast z-index below pinned-banner (or lower it) so the ✕ hitbox is not intercepted while the toast is still animating.
critical_code_review_comments: chat_extras.py find_one truthiness bug: Motor+pymongo projection returns `{}` when none of the projected fields exist on the doc. Combined with `if not msg:` this produces false 404s on brand-new messages. Fix applied for message_reactions and request_transcription; audit the rest of the codebase for `if not doc:` after find_one with restrictive projection.
transcribe_message_audio downloads the entire audio via httpx into a temp file — no size cap; consider adding a max content-length guard to avoid abuse.
pin_message stores a snippet cap of 160 chars but no HTML/emoji escaping; safe for now because it's rendered as text, but keep in mind if that field ever renders as HTML.

unpin_message does not verify the pinned_message actually exists before unsetting — idempotent but returns 200 even when nothing was pinned; ok but could return 404 for consistency with pin_message on unknown message.
In FE ChatPage.unpinMessage, errors are swallowed silently (`catch { /* ignore */ }`); if the API returns 403 (e.g. non-admin flow race), user sees no feedback.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: Motor's find_one with a restrictive projection returns an empty dict `{}` (not None) when the document exists but has none of the projected fields set. In FastAPI handlers, `if not msg: raise 404` treats `{}` as missing → wrongly returns 'Mensaje no encontrado' for every new message that hasn't had a reactions or transcript field added yet. Repro: POST /api/chats/{gid}/messages a fresh text → GET /reactions or POST /transcribe on that message returns 404. Mitigation: change `if not msg` → `if msg is None` (applied to chat_extras.message_reactions and chat_extras.request_transcription). Verified: after fix, both endpoints return 200 for fresh messages and the full test suite passes.
